user.title: EcoFlow Smart Charge
user.description: Select the EcoFlow devices and the provider entries; all entities are found automatically. No cloud credentials. New entries start in shadow mode.

data_description.pv_entity: Keeps the history of an existing Riemann-sum PV sensor. Leave empty to let the integration integrate the batteries' PV power itself (the load profile needs a few days of history first).

error.battery_count_invalid: Select at least one EcoFlow battery (at most 10), each only once.
error.duplicate_reserves: Each battery entity must be distinct.
error.source_invalid: Missing, unavailable, wrong or duplicate source, or empty tariff key.
error.unit_invalid: Source unit or value is invalid.
error.device_entities_missing: A selected device or entry lacks a required entity (SOC, reserve, Self-powered, charge/discharge energy, PV power, grid energy, forecast, price or best-price window), or it is disabled.

abort.already_configured: At least one reserve target is already owned by another entry.
abort.recovery_pending: Pending recovery: source mappings cannot be changed.

init.title: Controller options
init.description: Shadow calculates the plan without device commands; active controls the battery reserves.

data.capacity_kwh: Fallback capacity per battery (unknown models, kWh)

error.invalid_setting: Invalid or non-finite setting outside supported bounds.
error.invalid_mode: Mode must be shadow or active.

recalculate.name: Recalculate plan
recalculate.description: Refresh and evaluate the configured sources through the runtime. Shadow never sends device commands; in active mode the normal safety and recovery gates apply.

config_entry_id.name: Integration entry
config_entry_id.description: Select exactly one loaded EcoFlow Smart Charge entry.
